schema.text: What happens at the traffic light when you cross?
schema.help: Turning cars are vehicles that turn at the junction and drive across the crossing while the light for people crossing is green. Who should go refers to the right of way, that is who is allowed to go first.

options.text: Traffic light: when it is green for me, the cars are stopped
Traffic light, but turning cars still pass
There is a traffic light, but it is unclear who should go
The traffic light is broken or switched off

en.#What happens at the traffic light when: What happens at the traffic light when you cross?
en.#Turning cars are vehicles that turn at: Turning cars are vehicles that turn at the junction and drive across the crossing while the light for people crossing is green. Who should go refers to the right of way, that is who is allowed to go first.

en.#Traffic light, but turning cars still p: Traffic light, but turning cars still pass
en.#There is a traffic light, but it is unc: There is a traffic light, but it is unclear who should go

it.#What happens at the traffic light when: Quando attraversi, che cosa succede al semaforo?
it.#Turning cars are vehicles that turn at: Le auto che girano sono i veicoli che svoltano all’incrocio e passano sull’attraversamento mentre per chi attraversa è verde. Chi deve passare si riferisce alla precedenza, cioè a chi ha diritto di passare per primo.
it.#Traffic light: when it is green for me,: Semaforo: quando è verde per me, le auto sono ferme
it.#Traffic light, but turning cars still p: Semaforo, ma le auto che girano passano lo stesso
it.#There is a traffic light, but it is unc: C'è un semaforo, ma non si capisce chi deve passare
it.#The traffic light is broken or switched: Il semaforo è guasto o spento

fr.#What happens at the traffic light when: Que se passe-t-il au feu quand vous traversez ?
fr.#Turning cars are vehicles that turn at: Les voitures qui tournent sont les véhicules qui tournent au carrefour et passent sur la traversée pendant que le feu des personnes qui traversent est vert. Qui doit passer renvoie à la priorité, c’est-à-dire à qui a le droit de passer en premier.
fr.#Traffic light: when it is green for me,: Feu : quand il est vert pour moi, les voitures sont arrêtées
fr.#Traffic light, but turning cars still p: Feu, mais les voitures qui tournent passent quand même
fr.#There is a traffic light, but it is unc: Il y a un feu, mais on ne comprend pas qui doit passer
fr.#The traffic light is broken or switched: Le feu est en panne ou éteint

de.#What happens at the traffic light when: Was passiert an der Ampel, wenn Sie queren?
de.#Turning cars are vehicles that turn at: Abbiegende Autos sind Fahrzeuge, die an der Kreuzung abbiegen und über den Übergang fahren, während die Ampel für Querende grün ist. Wer gehen oder fahren darf bezieht sich auf den Vorrang, also darauf, wer zuerst gehen oder fahren darf.
de.#Traffic light: when it is green for me,: Ampel: Wenn ich Grün habe, stehen die Autos
de.#Traffic light, but turning cars still p: Ampel, aber abbiegende Autos fahren trotzdem
de.#There is a traffic light, but it is unc: Es gibt eine Ampel, aber es ist unklar, wer gehen oder fahren darf
de.#The traffic light is broken or switched: Die Ampel ist kaputt oder ausgeschaltet

tr.#What happens at the traffic light when: Karşıya geçerken trafik ışığında ne oluyor?
tr.#Turning cars are vehicles that turn at: Dönen araçlar, kavşakta dönüp karşıya geçenlerin ışığı yeşilken geçidin üzerinden geçen araçlardır. Kimin geçmesi gerektiği, geçiş üstünlüğünü, yani önce kimin geçme hakkı olduğunu ifade eder.
tr.#Traffic light: when it is green for me,: Trafik ışığı: benim için yeşil yandığında arabalar duruyor
tr.#Traffic light, but turning cars still p: Trafik ışığı var, ama dönen arabalar yine de geçiyor
tr.#There is a traffic light, but it is unc: Trafik ışığı var, ama kimin geçeceği belli değil

fa.#What happens at the traffic light when: هنگام عبور، وضعیت چراغ راهنمایی چگونه است؟
fa.#Turning cars are vehicles that turn at: خودروهای در حال گردش وسایلی هستند که در تقاطع می‌پیچند و در حالی که چراغ عابران سبز است از محل عبور می‌گذرند. «چه کسی باید برود» به حق تقدم اشاره دارد، یعنی چه کسی اجازه دارد اول برود.
fa.#Traffic light: when it is green for me,: چراغ راهنمایی: وقتی برای من سبز است، خودروها متوقف‌اند
fa.#Traffic light, but turning cars still p: چراغ راهنمایی هست، اما خودروهای در حال گردش باز هم عبور می‌کنند
fa.#There is a traffic light, but it is unc: چراغ راهنمایی هست، اما معلوم نیست چه کسی باید عبور کند
fa.#The traffic light is broken or switched: چراغ راهنمایی خراب یا خاموش است

hu.#What happens at the traffic light when: Mi történik a jelzőlámpánál, amikor átkel?
hu.#Turning cars are vehicles that turn at: A kanyarodó autók azok a járművek, amelyek a kereszteződésben befordulnak, és áthaladnak az átkelőn, miközben az átkelőknek zöld a lámpa. A ki mehet kérdés az elsőbbségre vonatkozik, vagyis arra, kinek szabad előbb mennie.
hu.#Traffic light: when it is green for me,: Jelzőlámpa: amikor nekem zöld, az autók állnak
hu.#Traffic light, but turning cars still p: Jelzőlámpa, de a kanyarodó autók így is áthaladnak
hu.#There is a traffic light, but it is unc: Van jelzőlámpa, de nem egyértelmű, ki mehet
hu.#The traffic light is broken or switched: A jelzőlámpa elromlott vagy ki van kapcsolva

ar.#What happens at the traffic light when: ماذا يحدث عند إشارة المرور عندما تعبر؟
ar.#Turning cars are vehicles that turn at: السيارات المنعطفة هي المركبات التي تنعطف عند التقاطع وتمر فوق ممر العبور بينما تكون إشارة العابرين خضراء. عبارة من يجب أن يمر تشير إلى حق الأولوية، أي من يحق له المرور أولًا.
ar.#Traffic light: when it is green for me,: إشارة ضوئية: عندما تكون خضراء لي، تكون السيارات متوقفة
ar.#Traffic light, but turning cars still p: إشارة ضوئية، لكن السيارات التي تنعطف تمر رغم ذلك
ar.#There is a traffic light, but it is unc: توجد إشارة ضوئية، لكن من غير الواضح من يجب أن يمر
